business_summary: Darling Ingredients Inc. (NYSE: DAR) repurposes and recycles materials from the animal agriculture and food industries through rendering operations, and discloses avian influenza in its own 10-K; the mapping census found it the only listed renderer in the population, the plane that absorbs culled flocks. The link is scored EMERGING, not UNDISCOVERED (impact 65, crowdedness 52, capture 45, as of 2026-09-10): the chain's own heat rationale explicitly corrects an earlier UNDISCOVERED prior, noting DAR has more than doubled off its 52-week low (66.37 against a range of 29.91 to 68.34) with twelve analysts and institutional saturation, and states plainly that 'the honest reading is that the move is far more plausibly about renewable diesel economics than about avian influenza,' rather than claiming the market has priced this specific driver.
